lean_source:
import ProofLab.Bridge

set_option maxHeartbeats 300000
theorem prooflab_result (P Q R : Prop) (h : P ∨ Q) (f : P → R) (g : Q → R) : R ∧ (Q ∨ P) := by
  constructor
  rcases h with h0 | h1
  apply f
  assumption
  apply g
  assumption
  rcases h with h0 | h1
  right
  assumption
  left
  assumption

#prooflab_audit prooflab_result
